name: Maverick Hunter - White Axl
desc:
2 Level 4 Machine monsters
If this card is Xyz Summoned: You can add 1 "Maverick Boost" Equip Spell Card from your Deck to your hand.
If this card is Xyz Summoned using at least 1 "Axl" monster as material, it gains these effects:
● Gains 1000 ATK.
● Cannot be destroyed by card effects.
(Quick Effect): You can detach 1 material from this card; equip 1 "Maverick Boost" Equip Spell Card from your Deck to an appropriate monster on the field. You can only use this effect of "Maverick Hunter - White Axl" once per turn.
strings: Add 1 Maverick Boost Equip Spell from Deck
Equip 1 Maverick Boost Equip Spell from Deck
